name: Strip-slice offset

source.description: An inspected editorial piece cuts an image into vertical strips and offsets them before they realign.

technique: An image or word is divided into strips that shift independently and then realign, suggesting analysis, fragmentation or a reveal.
purpose: Editorial reveal; express analysis or fragmentation.
visual_behaviour: Vertical strips of a portrait slide up and down by different amounts, then lock back together.
mechanics: N clones each clipped to one strip (clip-path inset), staggered y offsets with power3 ease.
failure_modes: Many strips on large images multiply paint cost

implementation.approach: Clone the element N times with clip-path inset(0 x% 0 y%) per strip; stagger y; candidate Studio.fx.slices.

provenance.observed: Classical sculpture faces are cut into vertical strips offset at different heights (approx., from overview spacing).

licensing_notes: Technique only; source imagery must be public domain or licensed (collage-design skill).
